description: The line plot illustrates the "Training Loss of 20M Data Size" across six different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Step," features a split linear scale with diagonally rotated tick labels; the left segment ranges from 0k to 80k with tick marks at intervals of 20k, while the right segment ranges from 420k to 440k with tick marks at intervals of 10k. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," also utilizes a split linear scale; the lower segment ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 with tick marks every 0.2, and the upper segment ranges from 0.75 to 0.85 with tick marks at 0.75 and 0.85. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, all exhibiting a noisy, rapid initial decline from the upper y-axis segment into the lower segment, followed by a gradual leveling off. The red line, representing ChemBART Small 20M, begins near 0.82, decreases to approximately 0.08 by step 80k, and remains relatively flat around 0.04 in the 420k to 440k range. The blue line, representing ChemBART Medium 20M, starts near 0.82, drops to roughly 0.07 at 80k, and stabilizes near 0.03 in the final segment. The green line, representing ChemBERTa Small 20M, starts around 0.82, declines to approximately 0.10 at 80k, and levels out near 0.06, remaining the highest line throughout the lower segments. The orange line, representing ChemBERTa Medium 20M, begins near 0.82, falls to about 0.08 at 80k, and flattens near 0.04. The purple line, representing ChemLLaMA Small 20M, starts around 0.82, decreases to roughly 0.06 at 80k, and stabilizes near 0.03. Finally, the brown line, representing ChemLLaMA Medium 20M, begins near 0.82, drops to approximately 0.05 at 80k, and remains the lowest line, flattening out near 0.02 in the 420k to 440k range.
